instruction: An intimate studio portrait photograph, captured in a medium close-up shot at eye level. In a minimalist indoor photo studio with a seamless white background, the red-haired woman in the blue shirt (R2) is on the left, leaning her head and upper body closely against her friend's shoulder while looking directly at the camera with a calm, serious expression. Beside her on the right, the curly-haired woman in the green crop top (R1) stands holding a silver water bottle in her left hand near her waist, looking directly at the camera with a calm, serious expression. The red-haired woman (R2) leans her head and rests her hands on the right shoulder of the curly-haired woman (R1), pressing their heads close together. The scene is illuminated by bright, even studio lighting with soft shadows, creating a clean white and pastel color palette.
